segments.name: Life Solutions
segments.description: Originates, buys, manages and services life insurance policies for policyholders, institutional investors and its own balance sheet.
segments.evidence: Within this segment, we also generate revenues from portfolio management and portfolio servicing.

segments.name: Asset Management
products: customizable free cash flow index strategies
segments.description: Manages alternative investment funds and ETFs invested in settlement contracts and free cash flow equity strategies for institutional and private clients.
segments.evidence: The Company's Carlisle and FCF subsidiaries manage alternative investment funds and exchange-traded funds ("ETF").

segments.name: Technology Services
segments.description: Provides longevity and health data technology services to pension funds, government agencies and insurance-related businesses.
segments.evidence: Technology Services fees are based on fixed annual contracts with clients including pension plans, life insurance companies, governmental agencies, and others.

revenueModel.text: Institutional investors, policyholders, funds and pension plans pay origination and servicing fees, asset management fees on assets under management, and fixed annual technology contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Asset Management fees are based on a percentage of total asset value under management.
